claims.text:
J.R.R. Tolkien noted that it was a custom in the Took family to use high-sounding names and that he turned them into old names of Frankish and Gothic origin. The name Sigismond contains sigis ("victory") and mund ("hand" "protection").
Category:Germanic names
Category:Hobbits
Category:Took
Category:Third Age characters
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix F, "On Translation", p. 1135
